title: EQT Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: EQT Corporation filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026, disclosing preliminary Q1 2026 derivative losses and cash settlement figures. The company expects a total loss on derivatives of $238 million and net cash settlements paid on derivatives totaling $304 million for the three months ended March 31, 2026. This is a standard corporate financial disclosure from a natural gas E&P company with no relevance to broad market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: EQT Corp expects to report a total loss on derivatives of $238 million for Q1 2026.
Net cash settlements paid on NYMEX natural gas hedge positions: $(114) million.
Net cash settlements paid on basis and liquids hedge positions: $(190) million.
Total net cash settlements paid on derivatives: $(304) million.
No premiums were paid or received for derivatives that settled during the period.
Final amounts are subject to change pending the Q1 2026 10-Q filing.
